fusions.name: Drizzle Weave
fusions.desc: Looses 5 drops at once, spread apart, each dealing 3 damage. Each hit has a 30% chance to leave the target [Soaked] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Sodden Drag
fusions.desc: A waterlogged lash that deals 12 damage, knocks the target back 2 tiles and leaves it 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Weighted Veil
fusions.desc: Raises a barrier that absorbs the next 24 damage and holds for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Waterproofing
fusions.desc: When you take non-fire damage, you gain a ward that soaks 20% of your maximum health for 6 seconds. Once every 20 seconds.
